notes.content:

- Fixed some minor visual bugs
I bet you didn't expect an update. We have a new game coming soon btw.

notes.title: 1.0.22 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
IMPORTANT
The name of the company was changed in the game build as it was just a placeholder before. This also changes the save location. To use your previous save, move the files at %AppData%\LocalLow\DumiGames\The Handbook to %AppData%\LocalLow\Ivories Studios\The Handbook

Changes:
Fixed a bug when leveling to level 42, the game would break.
Fixed a few typos.
Small bugs that didn't affect the gameplay, but still produced errors in the log.

notes.title: 1.0.19 Bug Fixes and probably final patch
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug with the mountain
-Shadow wolves do not stack souls anymore
Save files should be compatible with the previous version.
I belive everything is fixed now and this is the final update hopefully.
